text:
How are the vibrations we create detected and recorded by seismic sensors?

In this lesson, you will work with data from the Raspberry Shake in your classroom. Follow the instructions below to identify signals in the data!

Instructions

1) On the right you can see the Raspberry Shake: Data View. Next to the blue "Filters" button, type your classroom's Raspberry Shake ID in the search box.

2) Look at the time. Stomp your feet on the ground! Stomp your feet hard enough that the Raspberry Shake can feel the vibrations you create!

3) Look at the Raspberry Shake data. Can you find the signal that shows when you were stomping?

4) We will call your specific stomp the "stomp signal." When you find it in the data, take a snapshot of your computer screen (to do this, press ctrl + shift + 4).

5) Upload the screenshot to the "sketch" box below the Raspberry Shake data by clicking anywhere in the Sketch 1 box and clicking the upload image icon.

6) Use the freehand tool of the Sketch 1 box to mark your "stomp signal."

7) Answer Question 1.
